introHtml: Custom jute lunch bags, boxes, and totes offer a natural, textured look that stands out from standard nylon or polyester options. Whether you choose a Large Jute Tote for grocery runs or a Buffalo Plaid Printed Jute Tote for a rustic feel, these items pair well with screen printing or heat transfer decoration. Perfect for trade shows, corporate gifts, or retail giveaways.
